```{python}
#| label: setup
#| code-fold: true
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

# This report reads only files in results/ and figures/. It recomputes nothing,
# so a number here and the same number in the README come from one file.
#
# project.conf is located by walking up from the working directory rather than
# taken as a parameter, because the renderer works from the document's own
# directory in some versions and from the project root in others, and a report
# that cannot find its own config depending on how it was invoked is not
# reproducible. CSC_CONFIG overrides.
candidates = []
if os.environ.get("CSC_CONFIG"):
    candidates.append(Path(os.environ["CSC_CONFIG"]))
here = Path.cwd().resolve()
candidates += [here / "project.conf"] + [p / "project.conf" for p in here.parents]
conf_file = next((c for c in candidates if c.is_file()), None)
if conf_file is None:
    raise SystemExit("project.conf not found; run scripts/00_configure.sh first")

sys.path.insert(0, str((conf_file.parent / "scripts").resolve()))
import lib_csc as L

conf = L.load_conf(conf_file)
RESULTS = Path(conf["RESULTS_DIR"])
FIGURES = Path(conf["FIGURES_DIR"])
LOGS = Path(conf["LOG_DIR"])
PLDDT_HIGH = L.conf_float(conf, "PLDDT_HIGH", 90.0)
LDDT_TRUST = L.conf_float(conf, "LDDT_TRUST", 0.7)


def load(rel, root=RESULTS):
    p = Path(root) / rel
    if not p.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(p, sep="\t")
    except Exception:
        return None
    return df if len(df) else None


def show(df, msg="This table has not been produced yet."):
    if df is None:
        print(msg)
        return None
    return df
```

## What this measures

Two questions, and the second is the one that decides whether the first
matters.

How well does a confidence value predict the accuracy it claims to predict.
The confidence head of a structure prediction model is trained to predict the
model's own local distance difference score against the true structure, on a
scale of 0 to 100. It does not predict deviation after superposition, it does
not predict whether the fold is right, and it says nothing at all about how two
confidently predicted pieces sit relative to each other. So it is compared here
against the quantity it was trained on, computed the way that quantity is
defined, and the comparison is shown as a scatter rather than summarised as a
correlation.

And whether a confident structure is a physically possible one. A previous
stage of this work found that a docked pose can sit within 1.4 Angstrom of the
experimental one and still be chemically impossible, because nothing in a
docking score enforces chemistry. The same question is asked here of predicted
backbones and side chains, and the only figure called success is the one that
requires both accuracy and validity.

## The held-out set, and what a date filter is worth

```{python}
#| label: holdout
summary = load("holdout_set_summary.tsv")
show(summary, "The set has not been built yet.")
```

A date filter selects entries the models cannot have been trained on. It does
not select proteins they have never seen. Most newly released structures are
new determinations of something already in the archive, and the identity bands
in the table above are how much of that there is in this set. Those targets are
kept and flagged rather than removed: a target with a close pre-cutoff relative
is exactly the case worth measuring, and dropping it would remove the evidence
instead of reporting it.

which it is.

## The application arm

```{python}
#| label: pedv
for name in ("domain_definition.tsv", "deposited_pairs.tsv",
             "prediction_pairs.tsv", "prediction_confidence.tsv"):
    df = load(Path("pedv") / name)
    if df is not None:
        print(name)
        display(df)
```

The domain boundary above was derived from the deposited coordinates by
contact density, not taken from a published range. The displacement columns
report where a prediction places that domain against each deposited
arrangement, after fitting on the body alone. Resemblance to one arrangement is
not evidence that the others are wrong, and nothing here adjudicates between
the experiments.
